zh.headline: 微软发布首个自研网络安全模型 MAI-Cyber-1-Flash
zh.observation: 今天最显著的信号是 **AI 安全的"阵营化"**：英伟达联合微软、SpaceX 成立开放安全联盟（不含 OpenAI/谷歌/Anthropic），同时 Anthropic 发布开放权重立场声明，黄仁勋首次公开发声捍卫开源。行业正在围绕"开放 vs 封闭"形成明确的战略阵营，这将深刻影响未来的模型发布策略和企业采购决策。另一个关键趋势是 **安全 AI 的垂直化**：微软发布自研安全模型、Sakana AI 推出 Fugu-Cyber、多家机构同时押注网络安全 AI，安全正成为 AI 应用最活跃的垂直领域之一。最后，**Claude 共享聊天泄露事件**虽非技术突破，但暴露了 AI 产品在隐私合规上的系统性漏洞，所有 AI builder 都应引以为戒。

items.title: Anthropic 发布开放权重模型立场声明
items.desc: Anthropic 正式阐述其对开放权重 AI 模型的政策立场，回应日益激烈的开源与闭源辩论。
items.value: 为行业政策讨论提供关键参考框架

items.title: Claude 共享聊天记录被谷歌搜索索引暴露
items.desc: Reddit 用户发现 Anthropic Claude 的"共享聊天"功能生成的链接页面缺少 noindex 标签，导致部分对话（含密钥和法律问题）被谷歌和必应公开索引。
items.value: 提醒开发者注意 AI 产品隐私合规风险

items.title: 微软发布首个自研网络安全模型 MAI-Cyber-1-Flash
items.desc: 微软推出其首款自研网络安全 AI 模型，嵌入 MDASH 多智能体防御平台，在 CyberGym 基准上达 96% 准确率，成本比纯前沿模型降低 50%。
items.value: 企业安全 AI 成本降低 50%，复杂任务仍依赖 OpenAI

items.title: 黄仁勋首次发推捍卫 AI 模型开放访问

items.title: 英伟达成立开放安全 AI 联盟，OpenAI/谷歌/Anthropic 缺席

en.headline: Microsoft Launches First In-House Cybersecurity Model MAI-Cyber-1-Flash
en.observation: The most prominent signal today is the **"camp-ification" of AI safety**: Nvidia partners with Microsoft and SpaceX to form an open security alliance (excluding OpenAI/Google/Anthropic), while Anthropic publishes its open-weight position statement and Jensen Huang makes his first public defense of open-source. The industry is forming clear strategic camps around "open vs closed," which will profoundly impact future model release strategies and enterprise procurement decisions. Another key trend is **verticalization of security AI**: Microsoft launches its proprietary security model, Sakana AI releases Fugu-Cyber, and multiple organizations simultaneously bet on cybersecurity AI—security is becoming one of the most active vertical domains for AI applications. Finally, while the **Claude shared chat leak** isn't a technical breakthrough, it exposes systematic privacy compliance vulnerabilities in AI products that all AI builders should take as a warning.

items.title: Anthropic Publishes Position Statement on Open-Weight Models
items.desc: Anthropic formally articulates its policy stance on open-weight AI models, responding to the intensifying open vs. closed source debate.
items.value: Provides a key reference framework for industry policy discussions

items.title: Claude Shared Chats Exposed via Google Search Indexing
items.desc: Reddit users discovered that pages generated by Anthropic Claude's "share chat" feature lacked noindex tags, causing some conversations (containing crypto keys and legal questions) to be publicly indexed by Google and Bing.
items.value: Highlights privacy compliance risks for AI product developers

items.title: Microsoft Launches First In-House Cybersecurity Model MAI-Cyber-1-Flash
items.desc: Microsoft unveils its first self-developed cybersecurity AI model, embedded in the MDASH multi-agent defense platform, achieving 96% accuracy on CyberGym benchmark with 50% cost reduction vs pure frontier models.
items.value: Enterprise security AI costs cut by 50%, complex tasks still rely on OpenAI

items.title: Jensen Huang's First Tweet Defends Open Access to AI Models
items.desc: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang posts his first tweet on X, joining Google, OpenAI, and Meta in signing an open letter opposing restrictions on open-weight models.
items.value: Industry leaders take sides as open vs closed model debate intensifies

items.title: Nvidia Launches Open Secure AI Alliance, OpenAI/Google/Anthropic Absent
items.desc: Nvidia partners with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM and others to form the Open Secure AI Alliance, dedicated to building open-source AI security tools in direct response to frontier model security challenges.
items.value: Open-source security alliance forms, industry fragmentation deepens

items.title: Satya Nadella Warns: Companies Trusting a Single AI May Not Survive
items.desc: Microsoft CEO states companies without their own models or an AI gateway layer to separate prompts from models will face trouble.
items.value: Enterprise AI strategy needs diversification to avoid vendor lock-in

items.title: Google AI Overviews Become Default, Appearing in 43% of Searches
items.desc: Pew Research data shows Google AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, with users clicking traditional results roughly 50% less frequently.
items.value: AI search reshapes traffic patterns with profound impact on content ecosystem

items.title: DeepSeek Reportedly Halts Second Round Financing Signing
items.desc: DeepSeek's planned second funding round of at least 10 billion RMB has been voluntarily suspended.
items.value: Chinese AI star's funding pivot may signal industry adjustment

items.title: Ant Group's Bailing Releases Ling-3.0-Flash Native Hybrid Reasoning Model
items.desc: Ant Group's Bailing division launches a new-generation native hybrid reasoning model with breakthroughs in inference efficiency and capability.
items.value: Significant progress in hybrid reasoning architecture for domestic LLMs

items.title: Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence Partners with Nvidia Long-Term
items.desc: SSI announces a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.
items.value: Safe superintelligence research gains top-tier compute support

items.title: Enigma Raises $71M to Make Robot Control as Easy as Adjusting Volume
items.desc: The robotics startup secures a massive seed round led by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital.
items.value: Robot usability becomes a hot investment theme

items.title: OpenAI Study: 43.5% of ChatGPT Work Queries Involve Cross-Role Tasks
items.desc: OpenAI analyzed over 800,000 work-related ChatGPT messages, finding nearly half involve tasks from other professions, especially pronounced at small businesses.
items.value: AI blurs professional boundaries, reshaping how work gets done

items.title: Delhi High Court Rejects Major News Agency Copyright Injunction Against OpenAI
items.desc: Court classifies AI training as private use for the first time, dismissing ANI news agency's copyright injunction.
items.value: Landmark ruling breaks new ground in AI training data copyright case law

items.title: Anthropic Opus 5 Sets 30.2% Record on ARC-AGI-3 Benchmark
items.desc: Claude Opus 5 scores 30.2% on ARC-AGI-3, nearly quadrupling GPT-5.6 Sol's previous 7.8% record, and independently formulates reflection equations.
items.value: Qualitative leap in reasoning, approaching new milestone in general intelligence

items.title: Black Forest Labs Releases FLUX 3 Multimodal Flow Model
items.desc: FLUX 3 is the first multimodal foundation model learning images, video, audio, and robot action prediction within a single architecture.
items.value: Unified multimodal generation provides new paradigm for robot learning

items.title: Induction Labs Releases Photon-1: Unsupervised World Model Learning from Raw Video
items.desc: Photon-1 is a 106B parameter sparse MoE model that learns to simulate desktops, play checkers, and model billiard physics from raw video without action labels.
items.value: Unsupervised world model learning breaks the action label bottleneck

items.title: METR Proposes "Expenditure Horizon" Metric to Quantify AI Agent Cost-Effectiveness
items.desc: New metric monetizes cost-effectiveness of AI agents solving problems; initial results on NanoGPT speedrun are underwhelming.
items.value: Provides quantifiable framework for AI economic evaluation

items.title: Molt: PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.desc: Open-source framework designed for agentic RL research with compact, clean codebase readable and modifiable by AI coding assistants.
items.value: Lowers barrier for agentic RL research, accelerates experiment iteration

items.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing LLM Capability Frontier Through Co-Evolving Skills
items.desc: Proposes skill self-play method balancing task diversity and verification reliability, breaking through self-evolution method limitations.
items.value: Provides new methodology for LLM self-evolution training

items.title: Robostral Navigate: 8B Vision-Language Navigation Model Using Only Monocular RGB
items.desc: No depth sensors or multi-camera rigs needed; navigation across robot embodiments using only monocular RGB image stream.
items.value: Dramatically reduces robot navigation deployment costs

items.title: FinanceComplexQA: Agentic Reasoning Benchmark for Industrial-Grade Financial Documents
items.desc: Synthesizes complex-layout financial documents using expert knowledge, generating 2,000 professional QA pairs to evaluate agents in real financial scenarios.
items.value: Fills evaluation gap for financial domain agents

items.title: K12-KGraph: Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Educational LLM Benchmarking and Training
items.desc: Extracts curriculum-aligned knowledge graph from People's Education Press textbooks, covering prerequisite chains, concept taxonomies, experiment-concept links.
items.value: Provides structured curriculum knowledge foundation for educational AI

items.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention for Efficient Single-GPU Video Generation
items.desc: 5B and 14B parameter hybrid video diffusion Transformer generating 720p video on single GPU, matching full-softmax model quality.
items.value: Linear attention breaks computational bottleneck in video generation

items.title: Alibaba Open-Sources Code Review Tool open-code-review ⭐+980/day
items.desc: Battle-tested at Alibaba scale hybrid architecture code review tool combining deterministic pipelines and LLM Agent, with built-in rulesets for NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection.
items.value: Enterprise-grade code review open-sourced, directly integrable into CI pipelines

items.title: impeccable ⭐+849/day
items.desc: Design language specifically for AI coding assistants to better understand and generate designs.
items.value: Improves design quality of AI-generated frontend interfaces

items.title: Kronos ⭐+442/day
items.desc: Foundation model for the language of financial markets, using AI to understand financial language.
items.value: Open-source financial domain foundation model lowers barrier for quantitative analysis

items.title: Kimi AI Open-Sources AgentENV: Distributed System for Agentic RL Training
items.desc: Moonshot AI's Kimi team open-sources AgentENV, using Firecracker microVMs for millisecond snapshot, resume, and 16-way fork, MIT licensed.
items.value: High-performance sandbox infrastructure for agentic RL training

items.title: Perplexity Releases pplx CLI: Search API in the Terminal
items.desc: Single-binary CLI tool providing search capabilities for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and other coding agents.
items.value: Enables real-time search capabilities in-terminal for coding agents

items.title: FeyNoBg: Automatic Background Removal Model and Training Library
items.desc: Open-source background removal model and training toolkit, trending on Hacker News.
items.value: High-quality background removal open-source solution with custom training support

items.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-Native Agents in Any Environment
items.desc: Open-source framework supporting end-to-end training of complex reasoning harnesses like Claude Code and Codex.
items.value: Breaks through complex agent training infrastructure bottlenecks

items.title: OpenMontage: First Open-Source Agentic Video Production System
items.desc: 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills, turning coding assistants into full video production studios.
items.value: Full AI video production pipeline open-sourced, empowering content creators

items.title: Jensen Huang Defends Open-Source AI: Distillation is Fundamental to Learning
items.desc: Nvidia CEO states in Axios interview, "Distillation—learning from AI, learning from other people, and learning from other sources of knowledge—is fundamental to intelligence. AI also has to learn from something." He argues viewing distillation as theft or threat misses the point, with the future of AI depending on continuous knowledge sharing. This sparked heated discussion on Reddit r/LocalLLaMA and Hacker News, with the community largely supporting the open-source stance.

items.title: "I Don't Read Any Code Written by My Agents Anymore" — Bob Martin
items.desc: Software engineering legend "Uncle Bob" Martin tweets his current strategy is to not read code written by agents, igniting debate on AI coding trustworthiness. Supporters see it as inevitable efficiency gain, while opponents emphasize the irreplaceability of code review and understanding.
